label: Town of Castleton
header:
# Town of Castleton municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 5; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Castleton Selectboard members: Mark Brown (Parlimentarian [sic]), Richard Combs (Chairman), Mary Harris (Clerk), Robert Spaulding (Vice Chairman), and Rob Steele.

Town of Castleton official website, Selectboard page: seats Richard Combs (Chairman), Robert Spaulding, Rob Steele (Vice Chairman), Mark Brown (Parlimentarian), and Mary Lee Harris (Board Clerk). The town's fuller form, Mary Lee Harris, is recorded; the Secretary of State directory prints Mary Harris.

Town of Castleton, Warning for the Annual Town Meeting of March 3, 2026: Article 1 elects a Moderator for a one-year term. No official source publishes the 2026 winner; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed. Structure only.

Town of Castleton, Warning for the Annual Town Meeting of March 3, 2026: Article 1 elects a Town Clerk for a three-year term, and Article 55 asked the voters to authorize the Selectboard to appoint the Town Clerk under 17 V.S.A. section 2651e and eliminate the election.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Janice Buxton as Castleton's Interim Town Clerk.

Town of Castleton official website: the elected Town Clerk, Nedra Boutwell, resigned effective December 19, 2025; the Selectboard called an April 16, 2026 special meeting to appoint a Town Clerk and Treasurer; job postings of July and September 2026 describe the office as Selectboard-appointed, and the October 12, 2026 Selectboard agenda still lists the Town Clerk under 'Job vacancies update.' No current holder is verifiably published, so no membership is recorded.

Town of Castleton, Warning for the Annual Town Meeting of March 3, 2026: Article 56 asked the voters to authorize the Selectboard to appoint the Town Treasurer under 17 V.S.A. section 2651f and eliminate the election.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Abby Cohen as Treasurer of Castleton.

Town of Castleton official website: the town's Treasurer page named Abbey Cohen, but the Selectboard's April 16, 2026 special meeting was called to appoint a Town Clerk and Treasurer, 2026 job postings describe the office as Selectboard-appointed, and the October 12, 2026 agenda still lists the Treasurer under 'Job vacancies update.' No current holder is verifiably published, so no membership is recorded.

Town of Castleton, Warning for the Annual Town Meeting of March 3, 2026: Article 1 elects Library Trustees to five-year staggered terms (in 2026, one five-year seat and one seat for the year remaining of a five-year term). The board is recorded with five seats; its current holders are not published in any official source read, so no memberships are recorded.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists twelve Castleton justices of the peace: Patricia Albin-Diercksen, Gerard Ashton, Michael Bethel, Yvonne DeLance, Robert Grace, Mary Beth Hadeka, Jennifer Jones, Toni Lobdell, Deborah Rosmus, Laura Sargent, Patricia Schroeder, and Lilian Sheren.

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists twelve Castleton justices of the peace for the 2025-2026 term; they are the winners of the November 5, 2024 election for the office. The listing publishes no vote totals and no party designations for justices of the peace.
